template_data.headline_html: Four certs ranked by actual federal impact.

items.title: SDVOSB
items.desc: Highest ROI if you qualify. VA/DoD set-asides run deep, verification is cleaner now. Apply immediately.

items.title: 8(a)
items.desc: Nine years of prioritized access. Painful application — no cert gives more runway to build past performance.

items.title: WOSB / EDWOSB
items.desc: Effective in the right NAICS codes. Pull your target agencies' set-aside history before you invest.

items.title: HUBZone
items.desc: Real impact in specific regions and sectors. Often oversold everywhere else — run the research first.
